artifacts.contract: Scope-owned child contexts retained through join, cooperative cancellation, deterministic error aggregation; no forced termination or bounded cancellation latency.
Copied unsigned messages, finite buffered FIFO or acknowledged rendezvous, atomic select registration, close/drain and terminal cancellation; adapters retain borrowed frames until disarm/quiescence.
Single-executor actor, copied finite mailbox, generation-tagged incarnation and explicit death/restart; concurrent adapters and external-effect recovery need separate protocols.

PR-T73-02.question: Should multi-channel selection use a shared registration lock or separate channel locks?
alternatives: one shared hub mutex and predicate
per-channel mutexes plus a registration/recheck protocol
PR-T73-02.discriminator: Publish between the final empty observation and waiter registration; require no lost notification and exact close/cancel ownership under both implementations.
PR-T73-02.reversal_trigger: Measured contention exceeds the agreed bound and an independently justified registration protocol preserves the same semantics.
